  1. Tell HN: HN is being scraped for emails to scam

    • Email
    • Security

    123 points · 43 comments · 16 Nov 2026, 02:53 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — The Tell HN post warned that addresses published on HN, including in Who Is Hiring-style posts, were being used in phishing attempts, based on a unique email address that received a fake AWS-payment message.

    Discussion — Commenters compared aliases, catch-all addresses, spam filtering, and the trade-off between public contact information and abuse. The discussion shared phishing indicators and operational-security habits.

  2. Ask HN: What is the state of self-hosting email in 2026?

    • Email
    • Self-Hosting

    48 points · 36 comments · 13 Nov 2026, 19:06 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — The Ask HN post asked about the practical state of self-hosting email in 2026.

    Discussion — Respondents described self-hosting as possible but operationally demanding because of deliverability, reputation, monitoring, abuse handling, and redundancy. Many recommended relaying outbound mail through a specialist, ISP, SES, Zoho, or another managed provider.
